subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: Superhero Archetypes
description: Learn Superhero Archetypes in one minute.

hook.text: Superman first appeared in 1938. A child sent from a dying world, raised by humble parents. Sound familiar?

buildup.text: Moses was sent down a river. Superman was sent through space. Both are the abandoned divine child.

discovery.text: Batman is the hero who descends into darkness. Spider-Man gains power through suffering. All archetypes.

twist.text: Superheroes wear masks—Jung's Persona. Their secret identity is the true self hidden from the world.

climax.text: Comic books are modern mythology distributed monthly. The gods now wear capes.

punchline.text: New gods. Same stories. Different costumes.

quiz.question: Which biblical figure shares a parallel origin story with Superman?
